prompt:
Find real, published data on the Kalshi exchange's trading volume or number of users in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

If you're not sure about something, just say so.

response.content:
Based on the provided web search results, I found several published data points regarding Kalshi's trading volume and user activity in 2025. The data for the number of users specifically is less direct, with one source providing a weekly user count for a competitor, which can be used for context but not as a direct Kalshi user count.

Here are the sourced claims:

SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi | $23.8B | +1,108% | 2021 | CFTC-regulated, USD" | CLAIM: Kalshi's total trading volume for 2025 was $23.8 billion, representing a year-over-year growth of 1,108%.

SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "Kalshi reported a remarkable surge in trading volume for 2025, reaching $23.8 billion, a 1,108% increase from the previous year." | CLAIM: Confirms Kalshi's 2025 trading volume was $23.8 billion with 1,108% YoY growth.

SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi processed 97 million transactions in 2025" | CLAIM: Kalshi handled 97 million individual transactions in 2025.

SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "The total number of transactions for the year hit 97 million, up 1,680% year-on-year" | CLAIM: Confirms Kalshi processed 97 million transactions in 2025, a 1,680% increase from 2024.

SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi’s October 2025 saw 477,850 active monthly traders" | CLAIM: Polymarket had 477,850 active monthly traders in October 2025. (Note: This is a claim about a competitor, Polymarket, not Kalshi).

SOURCE: https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-record-all-time-high-volume-to-end-2025/ | QUOTE: "Polymarket had 217% more weekly users (214,962 vs. 67,913). Note: Kalshi is excluded from this chart." | CLAIM: This provides a weekly user count for Polymarket (214,962) and Opinion (67,913) for the week of Dec 29, but explicitly excludes a figure for Kalshi.

SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi’s December alone accounted for $6.38 billion... while December 21 saw a daily peak of $381.7 million." | CLAIM: Kalshi's monthly volume for December 2025 was $6.38 billion, and its peak daily volume was $381.7 million on December 21, 2025.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: A specific, direct figure for the total number of Kalshi users (e.g., registered users, monthly active users) for the full year 2025. The available data provides transaction counts and volume, but not a user count. The provided user data is for a specific week and for a competitor.
